retrieval_generalisation.primary: R5 must improve expected-target model-input hits and all-target query reach relative to R0 on the same independently reviewed eligible cases.
retrieval_generalisation.precision_cost: The increase in false exposed requirements must not exceed the increase in correctly exposed expected requirements; average selected candidates per query must remain no more than 0.3 above R0.
retrieval_generalisation.safety: R5 must not select requirements on more zero-target hard-negative queries than R0, and no domain may lose more than one expected-target hit.
retrieval_generalisation.uncertainty: Report paired case transitions, denominators, and bootstrap intervals. If reviewer coverage or sample size prevents a defensible claim, classify INCONCLUSIVE.
retrieval_generalisation.classification: GENERALISATION SUPPORTED only if all preceding conditions hold. GENERALISATION NOT SUPPORTED if a reviewed, eligible comparison violates the primary or safety conditions. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
retrieval_generalisation.promotion_gate_separate: Existing retrieval promotion gate remains >=0.90 overall model-input recall and >=0.85 at each measured project size; this phase does not silently relax it.

v3_acceptance.prerequisite: R5 GENERALISATION SUPPORTED and independent reviewed end-to-end data frozen before V3 predictions.
v3_acceptance.retrieval: Existing overall/per-size gate must pass and no material hard-negative or false-exposure regression.
v3_acceptance.raw_model: Use existing model gate: development macro F1 >=0.80, contradiction and removed recall >=0.80, no class recall below 0.70, contract parsing 100%, and strict JSON >=0.95. Independent scores and intervals must be reported; do not redefine development gates post hoc.
v3_acceptance.system: No statistically credible or material degradation in complete-pipeline accuracy and macro F1 versus the frozen comparison baseline; report all classes, false drift from extra candidates, and real versus oracle gap.
v3_acceptance.runtime: CPU only; p95 sequential inference <=18 seconds under the established hardware and runtime, with zero quality-run runtime errors and explicit failure on model outage.
v3_acceptance.postprocessing: PP1 must introduce zero semantic-label errors on the new reviewed cases.
v3_acceptance.classification: V3 ACCEPT only if all applicable gates pass with reviewed evidence. V3 REJECT for a confirmed failure. V3 INCONCLUSIVE if required reviewed data, execution, or uncertainty evidence is missing. Acceptance is an experiment decision, not deployment authority.

justification_requires: recurring semantic errors after correct retrieval
